column5: The banked 100% state depends on a named map alias reloaded before each cell-list lookup. Byte, extent and ordered-relocation checks pass and coordinates are preserved, but those repeated assignments are not established as original source structure. Removing the aliases restores 99.3541%; reversed accessor arguments, a current-map accessor and a named level result are also flat at 99.3541%. Treat this as a provisional exact compiler witness; investigate the original accessor/local boundary before accepting the reconstruction.

Retail retains three discarded narrowed-product quotients in one stack temporary; current C removes the arithmetic and clamp. PC98 confirms discarded results. Prior helper/division controls do not recover the stores. Seek original expression or inline-return boundary before CFG or register experiments.

Keep the correct body; seek evidence for the unresolved item/remapped live ranges or an original helper boundary.
